reviews.explanation: The target proposal is 石勒 (Shi Le), referring to the surface form 勒 in the Liu annotation. Candidate c0 is 石勒, the full name of the same person. Candidate c3 is also 石勒, the same person. Candidate c6 is 勒, the abbreviated form of 石勒, referring to the same person. Candidates c1 (鄧攸), c2 (攸), c4 (綏), and c5 (遺民) are all different people mentioned in the same narrative context.

The target proposal is 齊桓公 (Duke Huan of Qi), referenced in the Liu annotation. Candidate c0 is the same name 齊桓公, clearly the same person. Candidates c1 (劉琨) and c2 (温嶠) are different historical figures from the main text. Candidates c3 (管仲), c4 (管仲夷吾), and c5 (管夷吾) all refer to Guan Zhong, who was the minister serving Duke Huan of Qi — a related person (minister/advisor relationship), not the same person as 齊桓公.

The target proposal is 謝玄, referenced by the surface form 車騎 (his office title). Candidate c0 is 謝玄 directly, matching the target. Candidate c3 (㓜度) is 謝玄's courtesy name (字), as shown in annotation 003: '玄字㓜度'. Candidate c5 (玄) is the given name of 謝玄, also matching. Candidate c1 (山濤) is a different person mentioned in the text. Candidate c2 (謝安) is 謝玄's uncle (叔父), a related person. Candidate c4 (奕) is 謝玄's father (謝奕), a kinship relation.

The target proposal identifies 王子敬 as 王獻之 (Wang Xianzhi). Candidate c0 is 王獻之 itself, which is the same person as the proposed target. Candidate c3 is 王子敬, which is the surface form (courtesy name) of 王獻之, so it also refers to the same person. Candidate c1 is 王恭 (Wang Gong), whose courtesy name is 王孝伯 — he is the person being addressed in the text, not the speaker. Candidate c2 is 羊祜 (Yang Hu), whose courtesy name is 羊叔子 — he is the subject being discussed, not the speaker 王子敬. The main text clearly shows 王子敬 (王獻之) speaking to 王孝伯 (王恭) about 羊叔子 (羊祜), so c1 and c2 are different people from the target.

The target is 阮光禄 (Ruan Guanglu), an office-title reference to 阮裕. Candidate c0 is 阮裕, directly matching the proposed target. The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-04-wenxue-024-liu-annotation-003) explicitly identifies 裕 (Ruan Yu) in the 中興書, confirming the identity. Candidate c3 is the bare name 裕 from the same annotation, which is the same person as 阮裕. Candidate c1 is 謝安, who is the interlocutor in the story, not the target. Candidate c2 is 孫龍 (Gongsun Long), referenced in the annotation about the 白馬論, a different person entirely.

The target is 嚴仲弼, whose courtesy name is 仲弼. The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-08-shangyu-020-liu-annotation-005) explicitly states '嚴隱字仲弼' — that 嚴隱's courtesy name is 仲弼. Therefore 嚴仲弼 refers to 嚴隱. Candidates c0 and c6 are both 嚴隱 (same person as target). Candidate c3 is 仲弼, which is the courtesy name of 嚴隱, thus also referring to the same person. All other candidates are distinct individuals mentioned in the same passage (陸機, 顧榮, 吳展, 周俊, 士龍/陸雲, 張威伯/張畼, 掦烏, 朱永長/朱誕, 蔡洪, 項託, 顔淵) and are different persons from 嚴隱.

The target is 潁 (王潁), one of 王丞相's two younger brothers. The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-09-pinzao-018-liu-annotation-001) states 王氏譜曰潁字茂英, identifying 潁's courtesy name as 茂英. Candidate c0 (王潁) is the same person as the target. Candidate c4 (潁) is the same surface form as the target. Candidate c6 (茂英) is the courtesy name of 潁 per the Wang family genealogy, thus the same person. Candidate c7 (潁) is the same person. Candidate c2 (敝) is the other brother of 王丞相, thus a kinship relation (brother) to the target. Candidate c1 (鄧攸/鄧伯道) is the person 潁 is compared to, a different person. Candidate c3 (温忠武) is the person 敝 is compared to, a different person. Candidate c5 (茂平) appears in a separate annotation about 堂邑公, not clearly the same person as 潁.

The target mention is 桓宣武 (Huan Xuanwu), which is the posthumous/epithet name of 桓溫 (Huan Wen). Candidate c0 is 桓溫, the same person. Candidate c1 is 謝安 (Xie An), who is the subject of the anecdote and served as 桓宣武's 司馬 (military advisor) — a related person but not the same. Candidate c2 (傅先正) appears in the Liu annotation discussing a different philosophical point, not the target. Candidate c3 (桓玄) is 桓溫's son, a different person. Candidate c4 (髙靈) is the 中丞 mentioned in the text who makes the jesting remark — a different person from 桓溫.

The target mention is 宣王, which is the posthumous title of 司馬懿 (Sima Yi). Candidate c0 is 司馬懿 himself, matching the target proposal. The main text describes 王導 recounting 宣王's founding deeds, and the Liu annotation explicitly glosses 宣王創業誅曹爽任蔣濟, confirming 宣王 = 司馬懿. Candidates c1 (温嶠) and c2 (王導) are different people present in the same passage. Candidates c3 (曹爽) and c4 (蔣濟) are figures mentioned in the annotation as people 司馬懿 dealt with, making them related persons but not the same person.
